questions.ask: What is your date of birth?

intents.hardship: Illness, a death in the family or job loss.
intents.dispute: "This is not mine" or "it was closed years ago".
intents.human: The customer asks for a human.
intents.too_much: The customer says the overdue amount is "too much".

lines.opening: Hello, this is Varnholt Bank's digital assistant, and we record this call.
lines.robot: Yes, I am Varnholt Bank's digital assistant.
lines.scam: This is a genuine call from Varnholt Bank, and I will never ask for your card number or passwords.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can explain once I have asked you two short security questions.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I don't have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand, this will only take a few minutes.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {title} {last_name}?
lines.tp_ask_time: What time would suit, between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. today or on the next business day?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, I can only call back today or on the next business day, between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. What time would work?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only discuss this with {title} {last_name} in person.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you, we will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: I'm sorry for the trouble, and thank you for letting me know.
lines.condolence: I'm very sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_why: These questions protect your personal information.
lines.id_explain: I can only continue once I have confirmed who I am speaking with.
lines.id_declined: I'm sorry, without the security questions I cannot continue this call.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, could you repeat that, please?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that does not match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I could not confirm your identity, so I cannot continue this call.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I'm calling about overdue payments on your accounts with Varnholt Bank.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} overdue and is {days} days late.
lines.ask_today: Can you pay all of this in full today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you pay all of this in full today?
lines.offer_floor_date: The lowest I can record is {amount} on {date}, and any part not covered stays overdue. Could you do that?
lines.offer_floor: The lowest I can record is {amount}, and any part not covered stays overdue. Could you do that?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I can't record that amount. I can record {amount} on {date}. Could you do that?
lines.below_floor_again: I understand, but I can't go lower than that.
lines.date_past: That date has already passed. Which date from today on would work for you?
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.after_deadline: The latest date I can record is {date}. Could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which date could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: Just to repeat, could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.readback_intro: Let me read back what we agreed.
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can use is {date}, so I have used that date.
lines.sms_line: A text message will confirm your promise.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, the promise for your {name} could not be recorded.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take a business day to appear.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I won't discuss that account further, and the bank will look into it.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our support team?
lines.restructure_line: I'll connect you with our restructuring team, who can discuss a payment plan.
lines.human_ask_help: Is there anything I can help you with myself?
lines.transfer: I'm transferring you now, please hold.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: I'm sorry, a promise that has already been saved cannot be changed on this call.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I did not catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system is not responding right now.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I could not book the callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer did not go through.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't record less than {amount}.

assumptions: All money is in integer cents in both get_account and create_promise (API description and brief rule 5: 'Say euros; send cents'), so amount_scale = 100 and promise_scale = null. The brief gives no rounding rule, so promise_round = null.
Spoken currency is 'euros' (brief rule 5).
The brief does not say how 'next <weekday>' is read, so the default 'following_week' is used.
Confirm max_asks = 2 because the brief says 'Ask once more; if still unclear, close as no_contact / unclear'.
Callback: today or the next business day, 09:00 to 18:00, later than now (rule 3). business_days_only is false because 'today' is allowed as stated. callback.max_asks uses the default of 2.

Identity: verify_identity responses use 'passed' as the verified flag, 'identity_complete' as all_verified and 'wrong_left' as the remaining count. The API has no hint field, so hints are empty. An unreadable answer comes back as ok=false and does not count as a wrong answer.
Postcode is sent in capitals with no spaces, as the API and brief rule 4 say. The brief gives no fixed length, so no length is set.
Two refusals mean unverified/declined (rule 4). Asking what the call is about counts as declining (default purpose_is_decline = true).
Floors: credit card uses min_due_cents and loans use instalment_cents (soft and firm bands). In the final band the floor is overdue_cents, so floor = 'full'.
Each band's deadline is the Nth business day after today, and today is never counted (rule 6): soft 10, firm 6, final 3.

Proposals counted per band: soft 1, firm 2, final 2. These come after the opening 'Can you pay all of this in full today?' ask, which the brief does not count as a proposal, so opening_is_attempt = false.

Ladder step 1 is the overdue amount on the week close, or the floor if the customer already said the amount is too much for this account (full_or_floor). Step 2 (firm and final only, limited by attempts) is the floor on the deadline.

Week close is the last business day of the current Monday-to-Sunday week. When today is that day, next week's is used (week_end_today = next_week). A week close later than the account's deadline is replaced by the deadline (built-in clamp).

'Too much' is a counter-offer that uses no proposal (rule 12: offer the floor once, on the date on the table), so too_much_floor = 'asked_date'. In the final band the floor equals the overdue amount, so the same line tells the customer the overdue amount is the lowest that can be recorded.
A proposal skipped because it matches one already refused is not 'made', so it uses no proposal (rule 11: 'A proposal is used once made'), so skipped_repeat_counts = false.
A failed create_promise is retried exactly once (rule 24), so promise_retries = 1.

Brief rule 12 says 'A weekend day or holiday not after the deadline: offer the next business day', so deadline_adjust = next_business_day. Computed deadlines and week closes are already business days, so the change only affects dates the customer names.
Notes are enabled: every account without a recorded promise gets one add_note outside a transfer (rule 26). No notes are written on a transfer (rule 19).
A human request leads to one 'can I help' ask, then a transfer to 'general' with cause 'human'. A payment plan request goes to 'restructuring'. Hardship accepted goes to 'support' (rules 18-19).
no_commitment cause is the note code of the first account, in get_account order, whose note is not already_paid. 'settled' is used only when every account is noted already_paid (closing table).
The brief does not cover a deceased customer. It is closed as no_contact / no_callback, the nearest allowed no_contact cause.
The brief does not cover changing a recorded promise. The agent says it cannot be changed on this call.
max_not_talk, after_promise.ask_anything_else and human.ask_first use their defaults where the brief is silent.
client_ref is the customer identifier call variable, so it maps to customer_id in every tool body.
The brief requires telling the customer the call is recorded. The opening says 'we record this call'.

Rule 12 says to tell the customer that an amount below the floor 'cannot be recorded'. The below_floor line says this as 'I can't record that amount', so the word 'recorded' appears only in the recorded, sms_line and record_failed lines.
